title: Post-1887 Apache Wars period
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Post-1887 Apache Wars period", at revision 1370704919, opens: "The post-1887 Apache Wars period of the Apache Wars refers to campaigns by the United States and Mexico against the Apaches." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7313046, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "campaign period". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
